# ECC skill placement — adapted reference
Source: affaan-m/ECC docs/SKILL-PLACEMENT-POLICY.md at pinned commit in ../manifest.json.
License: MIT; copyright (c) 2026 Affaan Mustafa.

- Operational Codex skills live **once** at .agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md.
- Pinned external references live under third_party/ecc, never in automatically activated paths.
- Project agent roles live at .codex/agents/*.toml; AGENTS.md alone controls repository rules.
- Pin origin path, commit, checksum, adaptation, licensing and usage in one manifest.
- Never activate imported guidance solely because a reference file exists.
- Import only what has a concrete use, accessible references and no missing tools.
- ECC's global Claude-specific skill layout does not apply to this project.
